Title: Azure Red Hat OpenShift region expansion

Body.Content:
Azure Red Hat OpenShift is now generally available in Brazil South, Central India, Japan East, Korea Central, North Central US and South Africa North. In the list of regions, you can see where the service is available and where it's coming next.
